metadata.description: Shared source-facing actors and individual people, connected by explicit evidence-backed identity mappings

Actor.description: Source-facing participant or task owner that may represent a human, organization or software actor; identity with another entity is not implied.

Person.description: Individual human, modeled separately from a source-facing Actor; matching names do not establish identity.

representsPerson.description: Explicitly maps a source-facing actor to the individual human it represents in the cited source context; it is not equality and does not merge entities or infer a mapping from matching names.
